# S139 — Commit title without a Git section: fall back to 'ID: title', and check it before the run starts

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

S31 (2026-10-26): after the owner approved S78, ork ran the finish step and then paused at commit with 'the slice's Git section: the Git section is empty' (internal/engine/states.go:535-547, title.go:27). Almost no slice in this roadmap fills its Git section, so every ork run would stop at the last step after a day of work. The outer session filled S78's Git section by hand in the worktree so the owner could retry.

Owner to pick at preflight: (a) fall back to 'ID: title' from slicer show (recommended; matches the hand relays' commit messages), or (b) refuse at launch when the Git section is empty. Retry after a commit pause must resume at commit, not rerun finish.
